candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement 'pastBlockTime = block.timestamp;' so the recorded timestamp never updates, allowing subsequent calls to pass the time check immediately.
Delete the time-guard require so calls within the same timestamp are no longer rejected.
Invert the block number condition to 'block.number % 15 != 0' so payouts happen on a different set of blocks.
Move the assignment 'pastBlockTime = block.timestamp;' inside the if-block so the timestamp is only updated when a payout occurs.
Remove the require(msg.value == 10 ether) check so any value is accepted.
Remove the require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime) guard so multiple calls in the same block are allowed.
Remove the update of pastBlockTime so it stays at its old value.
Change the payout condition from block.number % 15 == 0 to block.number % 15 == 1.
Change the required call value from 10 ether to 1 ether.
Delete the statement `require(msg.value == 10 ether);` so any value can be sent.
Change the timestamp check from `>` to `>=`, allowing calls within the same block timestamp.
Delete the update `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp;` so pastBlockTime stays at its old value.
Change the modulo divisor from 15 to 7 in the payout condition.
Delete the payout transfer statement so the contract never sends its balance.
